GitHub #121 / Discord 2026-05-25 — Hades 8A43 exact ProductId profile added to avoid model-name-pattern inference. HP serial lookup reports OMEN Gaming Laptop 16-n0002ni / 6G103EA. Fan diagnostics show practical V1 ceiling near level 60 (GPU ~60, CPU ~58), so max fan level override is set to 60 for safer verification/normalization.

GitHub #216/#242 — OMEN 16-n0xxx (Ryzen 7 6800H + RX 6650 XT), ProductId 8A42, BIOS F.27. Issue #242 dmesg confirms AE_AML_BUFFER_LIMIT on WMID WMBA/WMAA/HWMC and hp_wmi failed to set platform profile 5: -22. The WMI BIOS command path (OMEN native) is non-functional on this board; power profile changes fall back to the hp_wmi/acpi platform_profile sysfs interface. Fan telemetry (EC RPM) confirmed working. Fan mode BIOS commands (WMI V1) may also be affected; EC path preferred. AllowDecoupledWmiThermalPolicyFallback=true ensures profile changes still reach the kernel.
